name: Acmea Autozeker
description: Achmea Autozeker racing-style game — collect tokens, track distance and laps; supports vehicle choice (bicycle, …).

translations.Note: Achmea Autozeker uses sharedCopy.game object — keys map to Unity translation keys

notes: Folder id is 'acmea-autozeker' to match the existing client project naming; Unity CDN uses correct 'achmea' spelling.
Uses TanStack Start (Vite) — env vars are VITE_ / unprefixed, not NEXT_PUBLIC_.
Verified end payload (May 2026 build): { score, playTime, collectedTokens, distance, lapsCompleted, payload }. payload is an encrypted base64 string the backend decrypts.
Current build has no PauseService GameObject — 'SendMessage: object PauseService not found!' is harmless. Remove boot.gameObjects.pause once confirmed permanent.
apiRequest event is handled by Unity — requires CORS proxy server action.
Default scene key 'example' — confirm with Unity dev before production.
CDN URL verified against the running acmea-autozeker-frontend/.env (May 2026).
